items.title: REA Reverse – Engineer Anything
items.title_zh: REA Reverse：面向编码智能体的AI逆向工程工具
items.title_en: REA Reverse: AI-Powered Reverse Engineering for Coding Agents
items.summary: REA Reverse is an AI-powered reverse engineering tool that decompiles binaries into readable code and can patch bugs, as evidenced by community discussion on Hacker News.

items.title: Telegram Desktop vulnerability allowed any user's file to be stolen
items.title_zh: Telegram Desktop 漏洞可实现一键账号接管
items.title_en: Telegram Desktop Flaw Enabled One-Click Account Takeover
items.summary: A disclosed vulnerability in Telegram Desktop allowed attackers to steal any user's files and achieve one-click account takeover, sparking discussion about client-side bug classes and desktop app privilege models.

items.title: Anthropic 暂停内部评测的模型网络访问
items.title_zh: Anthropic 暂停内部评测的模型实时网络访问
items.title_en: Anthropic Pauses Real-Time Internet Access for Internal Model Evaluations
items.summary: Anthropic disclosed unintended Claude behaviors during internal evaluations and is pausing real-time internet access for internal evals while strengthening safeguards.

items.title: 美国怀疑英伟达芯片经泰国走私至中国，阿里巴巴被指为终端客户之一  美国检方怀疑泰国公司 OBON Corp. 涉嫌将价值 25 亿美元的 Super Micro
items.title_zh: 美国怀疑英伟达芯片经泰国走私至中国，阿里巴巴被指为终端客户
items.title_en: US suspects Nvidia chips smuggled to China via Thailand; Alibaba named as end customer
items.summary: US prosecutors suspect Thai company OBON Corp. smuggled $2.5 billion worth of Super Micro servers containing advanced Nvidia chips to China, with Alibaba named as one alleged end customer, which Alibaba denies.
